node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate complete-fiber Vieta compiler
node.closure: exact twelve-fiber Vieta systems, square-root-free complete product-rank gates, a seven-skeleton negative injectivity cut, and a separator-only route cut
node.statement: Every actual coordinate packet has twelve deck-paired source-fiber edge records over K union {eta} union L^c. The positive and negative parity forms satisfy exact 24 x 8 and 24 x 7 Vieta systems. Their product halves give rank-at-most-five and rank-at-most-three matrices; positive parity must satisfy one 6 x 6 K+eta determinant. The negative ratio is a nonconstant injective Mobius map, cutting the 14 common-K pair-multiplicity skeletons to seven. Complete-system survivors realize all 24 stars, making forced colored support and the companion quotient identity consequences. The original F_29 profile-only witness fails the positive separator, while an exact defect-zero fixture census finds 140 separator survivors but no complete-product survivor among 5,040 assignments. This is not a universal orientation deletion.
